name: ATASHINORIRI: KAWAII CHISTMAS!
source:
All your friends at Neko Academy are having a Christmas party and you're invited! Find true love with a kawaii Neko-chan, and have fun at a Christmas party!

[Edited from [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18805]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
translation:
Neko学院的所有朋友正在举办圣诞派对，我们邀请你参加！与可爱的猫酱一起寻找真爱，并在圣诞派对上享受乐趣！

[编辑自[URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=18805]引理软论坛[/URL]]
